name: 埃文德·铁桦
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:209
who: Evander Ironbirch, a human man of the far north, the old hall guard of the Frost Hall at Frosthall City, sixty-one: about 188 cm, big-framed and broad in the shoulder, with a slight stoop of age and a bad left leg that drags half a step when he is off the horse. Short-cropped grey-white hair; a grey-white beard braided into one thick plait hanging down his chest with an iron ring tied at its end. An old scar from the brow bone to the cheekbone on the viewer's right side (his left), which goes purple in the cold. Pale blue eyes that look at where you stand in the line. Huge rough hands, the right little finger missing its upper half (on the viewer's left when they face us). A weathered, steady, watchful air; he counts the column from the rear.
face: FACE, as in the references: the face of a man of sixty-one, NOT young: deep lines at the corners of the pale blue eyes and mouth, heavy brows gone grey-white, a long old scar from the brow bone to the cheekbone on the viewer's right, a weathered, calm, level look. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 188 cm, big-framed: a wide chest and shoulders gone a little stooped with age, thick arms, a heavy, careful stride favouring the left leg.
palette: iron grey and faded white, birch-bark grey, old steel, worn saddle brown
casual: His everyday wear as the old hall guard: a worn iron scale jacket with a few plates missing here and there and bare leather showing through, under a faded white long coat that closes down the front with buttons, an iron-grey birch tree embroidered on the chest, a plain belt with a long northern sword hanging at the left hip, scuffed old riding boots. One big hand rests on the iron ring at the end of his white braid. A steady, watchful look.
private: Off duty in a hall-guard's room: a plain grey wool shirt with the sleeves rolled, a brown leather vest left unbuckled, dark trousers and soft old boots, the white coat folded over a chair. He holds a steaming tin cup in both big hands. A tired, kindly look.
battle: Leading the column on the road: the iron scale jacket with frost-rune lines etched along each plate, the faded white coat over it embroidered with the iron-grey birch, a long cavalry lance upright in his right hand whose head carries a small ice-blue crystal, the northern sword at his hip, riding gauntlets and boots. He stands braced and square, looking back down the line.
formal: At the foot of the hall steps: the faded white long coat cleaned and brushed, cut in an old military-house style with a wide folded-back collar and a few large iron buttons, the iron-grey birch tree sharp on the chest, a few scale plates showing at the neck, a plain steel clasp at the shoulder, the sword belted but sheathed, the braid with its iron ring over his chest. He stands very upright, a stern, proud look.
art: A weathered close portrait, the face tilted a little, the pale blue eyes looking straight at the viewer with a calm, level look, the scar catching the light. Cold white winter light from one side with a faint blue cast; foreground blur: drifting snow and the soft grey muzzle of his horse. He wears the faded white coat closed at the throat, the braid with its iron ring over his shoulder.

name: 丽芙
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:265
who: Liv, a human girl of Frosthall City, thirteen, living with her grandmother in the south of the city, a counter of people for a column of refugees. About 152 cm, a head taller than most girls her age, thin with long arms and legs, wholly covered by her clothes. Straw-coloured hair in two braids with the ends tied in red thread. Cold-reddened cheeks, chapped skin, clear blue-green eyes that look at you and ask which family you belong to. Tiny pale knife nicks all along the right index finger. She carries a white, peeled birch pole taller than herself over one shoulder. A serious, watchful, patient air.
palette: straw gold and red thread, white birch wood, wolf-fur grey, cold blue-green
casual: Her road clothes: a long wolf-skin coat that was her father's, far too big, the sleeves rolled three times and the hem hanging to her knees, over plain wool leggings and sturdy boots; round her neck a leather cord with a small carving knife on it. Over one shoulder a peeled white birch pole taller than she is, scored with notches. A serious, counting look.
private: At her grandmother's house: a long undyed wool dress with long sleeves, a knitted shawl, thick socks, the two braids with their red thread. She sits holding a short half-notched stick and the small knife, carefully cutting. A quiet, absorbed look.
battle: The long march: the oversized wolf-skin coat with the sleeves rolled, two more full birch poles tied across her back beside the one in her hand, the knife on its cord, boots wrapped in rags.
battle_pose: 3) the outfit of the march: planted and steady, the feet apart, a stubborn serious expression, gripping the tall white pole upright with both hands, two more poles crossed on her back; she does not fight.
formal: At the foot of the Frost Hall for the roll-call: a clean grey wool dress to the shins with long sleeves and a plain white collar folded flat, her father's wolf coat folded over her arm, the braids redone with new red thread, polished boots. She holds the white birch pole upright beside her, its carved notches faintly gleaming. She stands very straight, a proud, serious look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the blue-green eyes looking straight at the viewer as if asking which family you are from, lips closed. Cold pale snow light from one side. Foreground blur: the white birch pole with its notches and drifting snow. She wears the oversized wolf-skin coat closed up to the chin.

name: 希芙
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:321
who: Sif, a changeling child of the frost-spirit side, looking eight or nine though she is about fifty, living with Liv's family in the south of Frosthall City. About 126 cm, small and thin, light as a bird, wholly covered by her clothes except for bare feet. Hair so pale it is almost silver, fine as frost, with snow lying unmelted in a thin layer on the ends. Very pale skin, lips with a faint cold-blue tint, light grey-green eyes with a glint in the dark centre like a distant aurora. Thin, long fingers, always cold. She walks barefoot in the snow with a pair of soft leather shoes tied round her neck by a cord. A quiet, uncanny, gentle air.
palette: silver-white and frost, a bright wool red, pale grey-green, sheepskin cream
casual: Her everyday wear: a red wool dress her grandmother wove, bright against the snow, with a sheepskin coat that Liv outgrew over the top, its sleeves too long; bare feet, and a pair of small soft leather shoes tied by a cord and hanging round her neck. She holds the cord of the shoes in one hand, a quiet, wondering look.
private: Indoors by the stove: a long soft undyed wool house dress with a high neck and long sleeves, a knitted blanket round her shoulders, bare feet drawn up on the bench, the frost-fine hair loose. She holds a small cup of cool water in both hands. A drowsy, content look.
battle: The long march: the red wool dress under the too-big sheepskin coat buttoned up, the little leather shoes still hanging round her neck, bare feet in the snow.
battle_pose: 3) the outfit of the march: standing light on bare feet in the snow, a calm, uncanny expression, one hand held out palm up with a few snowflakes that do not melt on it, the other holding the cord of the shoes; she does not fight.
formal: For the evening of the roll-call: a clean red wool dress with a white collar and long sleeves, a small grey wool cape, her hair brushed smooth, the soft leather shoes at last on her feet. She stands quietly with her hands clasped in front, a shy, solemn look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the grey-green eyes with their faint aurora glint looking straight at the viewer, lips closed. Cold blue-white light from one side; snow resting unmelted on the silver ends of her hair. Foreground blur: slow drifting snowflakes. She wears the red wool dress and the sheepskin coat, closed at the collar.

name: 恩布拉
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:377
who: Embra, a human woman of the north, a huntress of the hunters' sheds in the north of Frosthall City, thirty-four: about 177 cm, tall, broad-shouldered and thick through the back, long in the leg, with the strength of a lifetime of drawing a heavy bow. Deep gold hair in one thick braid tucked into her collar. Cheeks reddened by wind, a white scar on the chin where a white stag's antler caught her at sixteen. Pale gold eyes like a snowy owl's, narrowed against the glare. Thick calluses on her hands, never wearing gloves even in winter. An easy, frank, practical air; the village children say when Embra turns around there will be meat on the snow. A short, thin white scar sits on the point of her chin (a pale line about two centimetres long), clearly drawn and visible in every close view of her face.
build: 177 cm, tall and strong: broad shoulders and a thick back, powerful arms, a D-cup, a firm waist and strong long legs.
palette: deep gold and snow white, wolf-fur grey, antler bone, horn black
casual: Her hunter's clothes: a wolf-skin coat worn fur inside with the outside side white-cured hide, so she vanishes in the snow when she lies flat, belted at the waist, wool trousers and tall fur-lined boots. On her back a great northern bow of horn and birch laminated together, its limbs thicker than her forearm, and a quiver of white-fletched arrows; a skinning knife and a coil of rope at the belt. A relaxed, sharp look.
private: Back in the hunters' shed: a loose undyed wool shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a brown leather vest unlaced, rough trousers, wool socks, the braid pulled over one shoulder. She sits on a bench cleaning an arrow shaft with a rag. A warm, tired look.
battle: Hunting on the road: the white-cured wolf-skin coat with small bone charms stitched along the seams, the great horn-and-birch bow drawn halfway in both hands, a frost crystal set in its tip, a white-fletched arrow nocked, the quiver at her back, the knife and rope at her belt, one knee dropped low in the snow, the pale gold eyes narrowed on the far distance.
formal: At the rear of the column at the evening fire: a clean dark blue wool dress with long sleeves and a soft folded collar, a white-cured wolf-skin cape clasped at the throat with a bone pin, her braid pinned up with a bone comb carved with a frost charm that shimmers faintly, the great bow leaning on her shoulder, tall boots. She stands steady, a calm, proud look.
art: A close portrait from a slightly low angle, the pale gold owl-like eyes narrowed and looking straight at the viewer, a small knowing smile, the white chin scar catching the light. Low cold sun from one side with a faint gold cast. Foreground blur: snow flurries and the tip of a white-fletched arrow. She wears the white-cured wolf-skin coat closed up to the throat, the thick braid over one shoulder.

name: 奎林
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:537
who: Quillin, a human boy of sixteen, a sword page in the palace at the Crown Terrace of Gold Kite City, about 168 cm, slim and still growing, long-fingered and light-footed, wholly covered by his clothes. Short ink-blue hair with one tuft at the front that will not lie flat. Fair skin, the tip of the nose red from the winter cold. Violet eyes that look at a person's hands first. Neatly trimmed nails. A quiet, careful, earnest air; he folds things square and never rushes.
palette: ink blue and violet, palace white, cold grey wool, worn leather brown
casual: His palace page's clothes: a white coat that closes down the front with buttons, the sleeves a little short at the wrists now, a white cord tied at the waist with a square-folded piece of white linen cloth hanging from it, dark trousers, two leather knee pads strapped on his knees, plain boots. Over the top in the cold, a grey wool blanket from the south bank wrapped round his shoulders. He holds his hands neatly at his sides. A quiet, earnest look.
private: In his small hut by the palace door: a plain undyed linen shirt buttoned to the collar, a dark wool vest, soft shoes, the grey blanket folded square on his knee. He holds the folded white cloth, smoothing it flat. A tired, patient look.
battle: The pre-dawn kneeling at the steps: the white page's coat with its cord and the square white cloth, both knee pads strapped on, the grey blanket folded and set aside, gloves off.
battle_pose: 3) the outfit of the pre-dawn kneeling: kneeling upright on both knees on stone steps, the back straight, a calm, steady expression, both bare hands resting open and flat on his knees; he carries no weapon and does not fight.
formal: For the day of the oath: a spotless white page's coat with a soft folded collar and large white buttons, a white cord at the waist with a freshly folded square of white linen, clean white gloves, polished boots, the hair damped flat. A small silver pin shaped like a sword rests at the chest. He stands very straight with his hands in front, a grave, careful look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face tilted slightly down, the violet eyes lifting to look straight at the viewer, lips closed, a calm, earnest look. Cold pale dawn light from one side, the nose tip faintly red. Foreground blur: a folded white cloth and a drifting breath of mist. He wears the white page's coat buttoned to the throat.

name: 弗洛里安
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:593
who: Florian, a human mercenary, a stand-in soldier for hire from the lower street of Gold Kite City, twenty-eight: about 178 cm, broad-shouldered and solid, built to stand a night watch on a gate tower. Closely shaved red hair, a small old cut notched into the viewer's right ear (his left). Grass-green eyes that crease to a slit when he laughs, and look very straight when he does not. A front tooth chipped by half, visible when he grins. Big hands, thick knuckles, calluses across the palms. An easy, warm, joking air; the table laughs half a laugh before he finishes his joke. Skin fair to light tan, NOT dark orange. One upper front tooth is visibly chipped, half of its length missing, clearly shown whenever he grins. A small V-shaped notch is cut out of the top rim of his ear on the viewer's right (his left), clearly drawn.
build: 178 cm, broad-shouldered and solid: a deep chest, thick forearms, a strong straight back, easy muscular legs.
palette: red hair and grass green, old leather brown, brass, oilcloth grey
casual: His company wear: a worn leather jerkin that closes down the front with straps and buckles, the badge of the Rustless Horn company stitched on the chest (a single bugle), a short brass bugle polished bright hanging at the belt, a short spear slung across his back with its head wrapped in oilcloth, rough trousers and scuffed boots. A bright, easy grin showing the chipped tooth.
private: In a lower-street tavern after work: a loose untucked linen shirt open at the throat, the leather jerkin hung on the chair, rolled-up sleeves, soft boots, a half-empty mug in his big hand. A relaxed, laughing look.
battle: On the wall at night watch: the worn leather jerkin with its company bugle badge, a short spear gripped in both hands with the oilcloth stripped off its head, the brass bugle at his belt, boots set wide, the green eyes level and unsmiling.
formal: For the winter's return to the city: a clean dark wool coat that closes down the front with buttons over a white shirt, the company badge pinned on the chest, polished boots, the brass bugle hung at the belt, hair freshly shaved. He stands upright with hands at his sides, a quieter, steadier look.
art: A portrait from slightly below, the head tilted, the grass-green eyes crinkled in a wide grin that shows the chipped front tooth. Warm low lamplight from one side. Foreground blur: the bell of the brass bugle and a drifting wisp of lamp smoke. He wears the leather jerkin closed at the chest, the bugle badge visible.

name: 莫里茨
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:649
who: Moritz, a human scribe apprentice in the clerks' room of the Tribunal under the Crown Terrace, nineteen: about 183 cm, tall and thin, a little stooped from years bent over a desk copying ledgers. Light yellow hair cut straight, one lock always falling over his forehead that he pushes back with the end of his pen. A narrow face with a pressed mark across the bridge of the nose from five years of clip-on lenses. Light blue eyes that lean close to the page. A callus on the first joint of the right middle finger and ink in the nails that never comes out. A pale, careful, bookish air; he reads a page longer than a face.
build: 183 cm, tall and thin: narrow shoulders, long arms, a slight stoop, stringy legs, a build for sitting, not for long roads.
palette: ink black and pale yellow, tribunal grey, light blue, old paper beige
casual: His tribunal scribe's clothes: a grey coat that closes down the front with buttons, black cloth sleeve guards pulled over both forearms, an inkwell, a pen case and a small paper knife hanging at his belt, a small leather case at his chest holding a pair of clip-on lenses (not worn, in the case). Ink-stained fingers hold a pen, a bound ledger under his arm. A shy, bookish look.
private: In his small lodging at night: a plain linen shirt with the collar open, a loose dark wool cardigan, soft slippers, the lock of hair pushed back with a pen. He leans close over a candle-lit page with the clip-on lenses pinched on his nose. A tired, absorbed look.
battle: The moment the order comes: the grey scribe's coat with its sleeve guards, the ink pot and paper knife at his belt, a heavy ledger clutched to his chest against his coat and a pen held reversed in his other hand, braced and nervous, the lenses pinched on his nose.
battle_pose: 3) the outfit of the clerks' room: standing stiff and wary, the feet together, a nervous but resolute expression, a heavy ledger hugged to his chest in one arm and a pen held tightly in the other hand like a small blade; he carries no weapon.
formal: For the day of the accession: a clean grey scribe's coat of the tribunal with a folded-down collar worn open over a white shirt, fresh black sleeve guards, a small seal pinned at the chest that glimmers faintly when the wax is warm, polished shoes, hair pressed flat. He holds a rolled document in both hands, standing very straight, a solemn, careful look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the head bent slightly forward, the light blue eyes leaning close and then lifting to look straight at the viewer, lips closed, a quiet look. Cool grey light from a window on one side. Foreground blur: a quill, a smear of ink on paper and a ledger edge. He wears the grey scribe's coat buttoned to the throat.

name: 维奥拉
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:705
who: Viola, a human maid of the Essen household in the upper city of Gold Kite City, twenty-two, daughter of a south-bank baker: about 163 cm, slim, round-faced, with the Essen household's grey eyes that she keeps lowered when she walks, so few notice her. Honey-coloured hair braided in one plait and pinned up under the maid's white cap. Burn scars across the backs of both hands from stoves and hot dishes. When she smiles there is a dimple in her left cheek, but she smiles rarely in that house. A quiet, quick, self-effacing air; she walks on the balls of her feet and never makes a sound.
build: 163 cm, slim and light: a C-cup, a narrow waist and modestly rounded hips.
palette: honey gold and housemaid grey, apron white, bread-crust brown, small brass keys
casual: Her maid's work clothes: a grey dress with long sleeves that closes down the front with small buttons, a white apron, a white cap over the pinned braid, a ring of small brass keys hanging at the waist, plain black shoes. In the dress pocket a piece of dark bread wrapped in cloth. Hands folded in front of her, the eyes lowered, a quiet look.
private: At her mother's bakery on the south bank at dawn: a plain flour-dusted linen dress with the sleeves pushed up, a cloth tied over her hair, bare forearms with the burn marks, wooden-soled shoes. She is kneading dough on a table. A warm, relaxed smile with the dimple showing.
battle: Down the back stairs at night: the grey dress with white apron and cap, the ring of keys clutched in one hand so it makes no sound, a silver tray balanced on the other, on tiptoe.
battle_pose: 3) the outfit of the back stairs: light on the balls of the feet, a taut, watchful expression, one hand clamping the ring of keys silent against her apron, the other balancing a silver tray with a glass on it perfectly level; she carries no weapon.
formal: For the household's spring banquet: a clean pressed grey dress with a crisp white apron, white cuffs and a starched white cap, the ring of keys polished, black shoes. She stands holding a silver tray of wine glasses, eyes lowered, a composed look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face tilted down a little then looking up at the viewer from under her lashes, a faint shy smile with the dimple just showing. Warm candlelight from one side. Foreground blur: the edge of a silver tray and the glint of brass keys. She wears the grey dress and white apron, buttoned at the collar, the white cap in place.

name: 宝拉
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:897
who: Paula, an old human washerwoman of Charcoal Lane on the south bank of Gold Kite City, seventy-two: about 151 cm, small and thin, her back bent with age. White hair in a bun held by a wooden pin. Both hands red and swollen, the knuckles thick, the lines on her fingertips smoothed away by sixty years of lye water. A deeply wrinkled face, kept very clean. Small, very pale blue eyes that look at your sleeves before your face. A brisk, shrewd, stubborn air; she knows where you were yesterday from a cuff.
face: FACE, as in the references: the face of a woman of seventy-two, NOT young: deep wrinkles at the eyes, mouth and cheeks, white eyebrows, small very pale blue eyes under heavy lids, a thin firm mouth, scrubbed clean. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 151 cm, small and thin: a bent back, narrow bony shoulders, a slight modest bust, a thin waist, but strong wiry arms that carry a basket of wet laundry.
palette: faded white and river grey, oilcloth brown, lye red, a little scrubbed pale blue
casual: Her wash-day clothes: a coarse linen skirt washed to near white, a loose long-sleeved blouse with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a heavy oilcloth apron over the top, a small pair of thread scissors and a reel of linen thread hanging at the waist, wooden-soled shoes that clack on the stone steps. Her red swollen hands rest on the apron. A sharp, shrewd look.
private: At home in her room at night: a plain dark wool dress with long sleeves, a knitted shawl, the white hair let down in a loose braid, soft felt slippers. She sits mending a sleeve with a needle, her red hands careful. A tired, softer look.
battle: Down the river steps: the oilcloth apron over the coarse skirt, the wooden-soled shoes, a heavy basket of wet laundry hoisted on one hip and a wooden paddle in her other hand, the small scissors at her waist.
battle_pose: 3) the outfit of the river steps: planted firmly with the back bent a little, a grim, stubborn expression, one arm hoisting a heavy basket of wet laundry on her hip, the other hand holding a wooden washing paddle low; she does not fight.
formal: For the evening vigil of the lane: her one good dark wool dress with a high white lace collar, a clean white apron, a black shawl pinned with a small plain brooch, the white bun neat under a dark cap, her best shoes. She stands with her red hands folded, a dignified, level look.
art: A close portrait, the head tilted a little, the small pale blue eyes looking at the viewer's sleeve then lifting to their face, a dry knowing look, lips closed. Soft cool grey river light from one side. Foreground blur: a wet white sheet on a line and drifting steam. She wears the oilcloth apron over the coarse blouse, closed at the collar.

name: 纳特
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:953
who: Nat, a human boy of Charcoal Lane on the south bank of Gold Kite City, an errand runner, eleven but looking eight or nine: about 128 cm, thin and small, wholly covered by his clothes except for his bare feet, with a thick pad of callus on their soles. Hair shaved close like all the lane's children, to keep off lice. Smears of coal dust on his face where he wiped sweat with his sleeve. Big gold eyes that squint first when he comes into the dark and then open wide. A quick, cheerful, slippery air; when he runs past, the cinders do not even crunch.
palette: gold eyes and coal black, faded brown wool, bare skin tones, polished steel
casual: His runner's clothes: an old coat of his father's, hopelessly big, the sleeves rolled five times and the hem hanging to his knees, closed up the front with a few mismatched buttons, over short trousers; no shoes. A rope tied round his waist with a polished iron strip dangling from it for tapping on pipes. A bright, quick look.
private: At home in the lane: a long-sleeved undyed wool tunic and plain trousers, a blanket round his shoulders, bare feet drawn up on a bench, his face washed. He holds a hunk of bread in both hands. A sleepy, contented look.
battle: The night of the run: the oversized coat flapping, the rope at his waist with the iron strip, bare feet, soot on his face.
battle_pose: 3) the outfit of the run: mid-stride and light, a fierce, alert expression, one hand lifting the iron strip on its rope to tap a rhythm on a pipe, the other arm swung back for balance; he does not fight.
formal: For the lane's gathering: a clean dark wool coat just his size with a soft folded collar and a few big mismatched buttons, his hair freshly shaved, his face scrubbed, for once a pair of small boots, the iron strip from his rope belt hung on a cord and giving a faint spark when touched. He stands straight with his hands in front, a solemn, wide-eyed look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the big gold eyes wide and looking straight at the viewer, lips closed, a bright, alert look. Warm lamp glow from one side. Foreground blur: a rusty pipe and a drifting wisp of coal smoke. He wears the oversized coat closed at the collar.

name: 温克
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:1009
who: Wink, a goblin researcher of the Magical Engineering College of the Arcane Society at the Star Ring, a hundred and sixty-three, looking like a wiry middle-aged goblin: about 104 cm, only waist-high to a human, with a large head and thin body. Pale sage-green skin. A pair of long pointed ears, each tip hung with a small copper ring. A long nose and round, bright yellow eyes, a round magnifying lens clipped over his left eye. Fingers thin and long, nails clipped short, the fingertips full of tiny burn scars. Untidy grey-white hair with a stray piece of copper wire stuck in it. An eager, restless, listening air; his ears swing toward any machine that hums.
face: FACE, as in the references: a goblin's face, large-headed and wiry, NOT a child's: a long nose, round bright yellow eyes with fine lines at the corners, a round magnifying lens clipped over the left eye, long pointed ears each with a small copper ring at the tip, a wide thin-lipped mouth. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
palette: oil-stained leather brown and copper, brass, sage green, grey-white
casual: His workshop clothes: a greasy leather coat with so many pockets he cannot count them, each holding one thing, closed down the front with brass buttons; across the chest a leather thong strung with a row of little brass reeds of different lengths; a worn cowhide notebook bound with wire hanging at the belt. The lens over his left eye. An eager, bright look.
private: In his room at the Star Ring after hours: a rumpled linen shirt with the collar open and the sleeves pushed up, a loose knitted waistcoat, soft slippers, the lens pushed up on his forehead. He holds a small half-assembled brass mechanism and a tiny screwdriver. An absorbed, happy look.
battle: Out in the field at the machine: the greasy pocketed leather coat, the row of brass reeds on its thong across the chest, the notebook at the belt, a big brass winding key in one hand and a small brass reed whistle lifted to his mouth, the lens in place.
battle_pose: 3) the outfit of the field: crouched and braced, a keen, tense expression, one hand lifting a small brass reed whistle to his lips, the other holding a large winding key out toward unseen machines; he carries no weapon.
formal: For the Society's long table: a clean dark green velvet coat with a wide open collar over a white shirt, the row of polished brass reeds on its thong worn like a chain of office, one reed softly humming, the notebook under his arm, the copper rings in his ears polished, his hair slicked down. He stands upright and a little proud.
art: A close portrait from slightly below, the head tilted, one long ear swivelled toward something off to the side, the yellow eyes bright through the lens, a keen smile. Warm orange workshop light from one side. Foreground blur: a brass reed on a thong, a spring and drifting steam. He wears the pocketed leather coat closed up to the throat.

name: 格哈德·科勒
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:1065
who: Gerhard Koller, a human city guard of the Crown Terrace of Gold Kite City, posted at the mouth of Charcoal Lane on the south bank, thirty-five: about 186 cm, tall, thick in the waist and shoulders, a big man. Square face with an old scar from a shaving cut on the chin. Light gold hair cropped to the scalp in the guard's way. A high-bridged nose whose nostrils flare as if smelling something. Steel-blue eyes that look at the gap behind you first. Huge hands with brick dust worked into the creases that never washes out. A solid, steady, plain-spoken air; when he stands in a gap, it feels already sealed.
build: 186 cm, tall and heavily built: wide shoulders, a thick waist, thick arms, planted legs.
palette: guard grey-blue and brass, brick red dust, light gold, steel blue
casual: His city guard's uniform: a grey-blue coat that closes down the front with buttons, a copper guard's badge on the chest, a belt with a short sword at the left hip, sturdy dark boots, a long guard's spear held upright in his right hand. Brick dust in the creases of his hands. A steady, plain look.
private: Off duty at home: a plain undyed wool shirt with the sleeves rolled, a brown leather waistcoat unbuttoned, dark trousers, worn slippers. He holds a clay mug of tea in both big hands. A tired, quiet look.
battle: At the mouth of the lane while sealing the gaps: the grey-blue coat with its copper badge, the long spear held in both hands lowered and braced across the opening, the short sword at his hip, and a mason's trowel hanging at his belt, boots planted wide.
formal: For the guard's roll: a clean pressed grey-blue city guard coat with a folded-down collar and brass buttons, the copper badge polished and faintly engraved with a ward-rune, a white shoulder sash, a mason's trowel at the belt, polished boots, the spear upright at his side. He stands rigid and square, a solemn, steady look.
art: A portrait from slightly below, the head level, the steel-blue eyes looking straight at the viewer, the nostrils faintly flared, a stern calm look. Dusty golden afternoon light from one side. Foreground blur: drifting brick dust and the point of a spear. He wears the grey-blue guard's coat buttoned to the collar with its copper badge.

name: 妮维
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:1231
who: Niv, a long-lived demon-kin girl of the Long-lived clan, forty-three in years but, as her folk grow very slowly, looking fifteen or sixteen, who tends the sick in the camp outside the Red Mud City: about 161 cm, slim, wholly covered by her clothes, long thin fingers with nails clipped very short. No horns, no scales, no tail; only the tips of her ears are slightly pointed, so strangers take her for an elf. Snow-white hair at shoulder length, cut by her own knife and ragged. Pale gold eyes by day that burn a steady dark gold at night, not flickering in the wind or when she cries. A row of fine pale scars across the inside of the left wrist (on the viewer's right when they face us). A quiet, steady, hardly speaking air.
palette: snow white and pale ash grey, dark gold, herb green, worn apron beige
casual: Her camp clothes: a long pale grey robe of her people, closed down the front with small buttons, with wide cuffs, the left sleeve rolled up to the elbow to show the name embroidered inside it by her mother; over the robe an apron with a wooden spoon and a small bundle of dried herbs in its pocket; soft-soled shoes that make no sound. Her hands folded in front of her, a quiet look.
private: In her tent at night: a plain high-necked undyed linen dress with long sleeves, a grey wool shawl closed over it, the ragged white hair loose, soft shoes. She sits by a little lamp with a small cup of broth in both hands, the dark gold eyes steady. A tired, gentle look.
battle: Carrying the pot through the camp: the pale grey robe with the left sleeve rolled up, the apron with its wooden spoon and herb bundle, soft-soled shoes, both hands gripping a big steaming iron pot of soup held level in front of her.
battle_pose: 3) the outfit of the night watch over the wounded: steady and upright, a calm, unflinching expression, both hands carrying a heavy steaming soup pot held perfectly level, not spilling a drop; she carries no weapon.
formal: For the camp's evening gathering: a clean pale grey robe closed to the throat with a white collar, the sleeves down for once, a simple grey shawl clasped at the chest, her white hair combed, soft shoes. She stands with her hands clasped in front, a still, quiet look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face tilted slightly down then lifting, the pale gold eyes looking straight at the viewer with a steady glow, lips closed. Cold blue night light from one side with the faint warm glow of a camp fire on her cheek. Foreground blur: drifting steam from a pot and a wooden spoon. She wears the pale grey robe closed at the throat.
art_extra: Her hair stays snow-white, only faintly shaded with cool grey, NOT tinted blue or violet by the light.

name: 雅戈·拾火
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:1288
who: Yago Firegleaner, a tiefling archer and arrow-maker of the outermost ring of the camp outside the Red Mud City, thirty: about 184 cm, tall and broad-shouldered, his left arm a size thicker than his right from drawing the bow. A pair of short horns on the forehead curving backward, the tips burnt black. One eye grey and one eye red. Black hair gathered into a bunch at the back of the head and tied with a length of old bowstring. A scar on the chin where a splitting bow limb snapped back at twelve. A rough, wry, unhurried air; the fires of the camp go up for him that the altar's fire does not.
build: 184 cm, tall: broad shoulders, a thick left arm and a long reach, a solid waist and strong legs.
palette: soot black and ember red, burnt horn tips, hardened leather brown, bowstring cream
casual: His arrow-maker's clothes: a stiff cured leather vest with a row of arrow loops sewn across the chest, a small hooked whittling knife, a coil of linen thread and a pot of fish glue hanging at the belt, a bow he made himself slung across his back, a long-sleeved wool shirt with the sleeves rolled, and boots worn through and patched. A wry, easy look.
private: By the fire after the day's work: a loose undyed wool shirt with the sleeves pushed up, the leather vest left off, rough trousers, the patched boots kicked off, bare ankles. He sits whittling an arrow shaft with the small hooked knife, shavings in his lap. A quiet, absorbed look.
battle: On the outer ring of the camp: the stiff leather vest with its arrow loops, the home-made short bow drawn full with a shaft nocked whose feathers glow like embers, the thick left arm steady, the quiver of arrows at his hip, the burnt horn tips black against the red sky, one eye grey and one eye red narrowed on the target.
formal: At the camp's gathering by the fire: a clean dark wool coat that closes down the front with buttons, a plain red sash, the horn tips polished, his hair tied back with a new length of cord, his patched boots polished. The bow hangs on a tent pole behind him. He stands with arms folded, a calm, steady look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the grey and red eyes looking straight at the viewer, a wry half-smile. Hard orange firelight from one side lighting the burnt horn tips and the scar on his chin. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and a feathered arrow shaft. He wears the leather vest over the wool shirt, closed at the collar.

name: 德尔斯
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:1344
who: Dels, a demon-kin man of the Crimson Feast line, a blood-collector of the Red Mud City, fifty-six but looking about thirty-two, only the eyes aged: about 176 cm, slim, his back very straight from thirty-one years of carrying a box. Pale skin, lips of a dark colour as is usual for his line. A pair of small horns hugging the forehead and sweeping back, the tips neatly filed. Ash-brown hair swept smoothly back. Deep wine-red eyes. A patch of white callus on the right palm from pressing the seal. He never looks at a face when he speaks; he looks at the wrists. A precise, courteous, reserved air.
face: FACE, as in the references: the face of a man who looks about thirty-two but has old, weary, deep wine-red eyes under level brows; pale skin, dark-toned lips, small neatly filed horns hugging the forehead, a thin firm mouth, a calm, attentive look. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 176 cm, slim and straight-backed: narrow shoulders with a groove from a box strap pressed into one of them, a lean frame.
palette: deep crimson and black lacquer, pale skin, wine red, wax yellow
casual: His collector's clothes: a deep red coat buttoned right up to the chin with very narrow cuffs so no blood can reach the sleeves; on his back a black lacquered box on a strap; at the belt a small knife, a roll of fine cloth and a block of wax; on his chest a small leather pouch holding the seal. His hands, white-calloused on the right palm, are folded in front. A courteous, reserved look.
private: In the room behind his house: a plain dark grey wool shirt buttoned to the collar, a simple dark waistcoat, soft slippers, the lacquered box set on the table. He is polishing a small glass vial with a cloth. A tired, quiet look.
battle: Making his rounds on the road: the deep red coat buttoned to the chin, the black lacquered box strapped to his back, a small knife held reversed low in his right hand, the pouch with the seal at his chest, boots planted, the wine-red eyes fixed on a wrist.
formal: For the day of the reckoning: the deep red blood-collector's coat of fine wool closed close under the jaw with very narrow cuffs, black wax seals strung along the front, polished black boots, white gloves, a black cord at the neck, the lacquered box gleaming with a thin line of dull red runes along its lid. He stands very straight, a formal, calm look.
art: A close portrait, the head tilted slightly down, the deep wine-red eyes lifting to look straight at the viewer, lips closed, a cool, precise look. Dim warm lamplight from one side glinting on the black lacquer box strap. Foreground blur: small glass vials and a drop of red wax. He wears the deep red coat buttoned to the chin.

name: 苏伦
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:1400
who: Suren, a long-lived demon-kin woman of the Long-lived clan, four hundred and seventy-four but looking about thirty-five, a wandering name-singer who walks between the camps of the west: about 172 cm, tall and slim, a slight stoop from listening to others sing with her head down. Long silver-grey hair in one thick braid with eleven short lengths of faded coloured thread woven into it. A smooth face without wrinkles but two fine lines at the corners of her eyes from squinting to see distances for others. Violet eyes that glow at night and gaze at a person for a long time. A gentle, patient, attentive air.
build: 172 cm, tall and slim: a B-cup, a narrow waist, long legs.
palette: silver-grey and violet, faded thread colours, old cloak grey, worn wood
casual: Her wandering singer's clothes: an old long cloak washed until its colour cannot be told, with several hidden pockets sewn inside, over a plain long-sleeved grey dress that closes down the front with buttons; a staff taller than she is, its head polished smooth by hands, which was her teacher's; on the left cuff of the dress her own name embroidered in thread. A gentle, listening look. No lettering, writing or embroidered text anywhere on the clothes.
private: By a camp fire at night: a soft undyed wool dress with long sleeves, a grey shawl round her shoulders, the silver braid pulled over one shoulder, the staff laid across her knees. She sits with her mouth closed, listening to the fire. A quiet, tender look.
battle: Walking the camps: the old cloak thrown back, the staff held upright in both hands, her chin lifted and her mouth open to sing, the silver braid swinging with its eleven coloured threads.
formal: For the naming at the great fire: a clean pale grey long robe of her clan with a soft rolled collar and a name embroidered inside the left sleeve, the old cloak brushed and clasped at the shoulder with a bone pin, the silver braid pinned up with its eleven coloured threads, the staff upright at her side with its head giving off a faint hum. She stands tall, a solemn, warm look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the head tilted a little, the violet eyes looking straight at the viewer for a long moment with a faint smile, lips softly closed. Warm firelight from one side with a cold violet edge on the other. Foreground blur: the faded coloured threads of the braid and drifting sparks. She wears the old cloak closed at the throat.

name: 萨丝卡
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:1554
who: Saska, a lizardfolk woman of the East Spring in the southern marsh, sixty, who watches the eggs beside the warm mud: about 178 cm, tall, with a long body and a thick tail dragging to her heels. Reed-yellow scales with brown stripes down the back and a paler throat, like a sun-bleached reed leaf. A row of short spines on the crown of the head, lying flat. Amber eyes with slit pupils and eyelids that close sideways, slowly when she thinks. Four fingers on each hand with hard fingertips. A forked tongue that flicks out to touch the air when she speaks. A patient, slow-moving, motherly air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lizardfolk woman's face, NOT human: reed-yellow scales with a paler throat, a short row of flat spines on the crown, large amber slit-pupilled eyes with sideways-closing lids, a narrow snout with small nostrils, a wide thin mouth with a forked tongue just showing. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 178 cm, tall and long-bodied: a slim flat-chested frame, a narrow waist, a thick strong tail and long legs.
palette: reed yellow and brown stripe, amber, wet mud brown, salt white
casual: Her egg-keeper's clothes: a woven reed apron over a plain sleeveless dress of undyed linen, a leather cord belt with a small clay jar of white salt scraped from the spring's edge hanging from it, a hollow reed pipe on a cord round her neck. Her tail laid out behind her. She carries no weapon; her four-fingered hands warm against a stone. A calm, patient look.
private: In her shed by the warm mud at night: a loose undyed linen robe with short sleeves, a woven grass mat to sit on, her tail curled around her feet, the reed apron hung up. She holds a small warm egg-shaped stone in both hands. A drowsy, content look.
battle: Watching the clutch: the reed apron over the linen dress, the clay jar of salt at her belt, the long hollow reed pipe pressed into the mud mound in one hand while she bends close, the tail braced behind her.
battle_pose: 3) the outfit of the egg-watch: crouched low and still beside a warm mud mound, a patient, intent expression, one four-fingered hand pressed flat on the mound and the other holding a reed pipe to her mouth to taste the air from inside; she carries no weapon.
formal: For the hatching feast: a clean linen robe with a woven reed collar and a band of white salt-coloured embroidery, a polished clay jar of salt in both hands, her scales oiled to shine, the spines freshly brushed. She stands upright with her tail laid straight behind, a warm, solemn look.
art: A close portrait, the head tilted, the amber slit-pupilled eyes looking straight at the viewer, the side-closing lids half lowered, the forked tongue just touching the air. Warm steam-hazed light from one side. Foreground blur: the rim of a clay salt jar and a drifting curl of steam off a warm mud mound. She wears the woven reed apron over the linen dress.

name: 阿莎
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:1610
who: Asha, a demon-kin woman of the Nightwing line, a water-carrier of the West Spring in the southern marsh, thirty-five: about 168 cm, slim and light-boned, with the shoulders and back of someone who has flown for years. A pair of grey-brown wings folded on her shoulders like an old cloak, the membranes crudely patched in nine places with uneven stitches she sewed herself with a bone needle. Short dark teal hair with one thin braid left behind the ear. Teal eyes that see far in the dark and squint in the day. Lips always dry and cracked. Bare feet. A thin, tired, resourceful air; she lands without a sound, and you hear the water slosh in the skins first.
build: 168 cm, slim and light: narrow shoulders with strong flight muscles across the back, a B-cup, a slim waist and long legs.
palette: grey-brown wing and dark teal, waterskin leather, dry reed beige, dusk grey
casual: Her water-carrier's clothes: a short leather jerkin cut open in two slits down the back so her wings pass through, six leather waterskins hanging at her belt, flat and empty against her side, short trousers wrapped in reed-cloth, no shoes; on her back a short bow, her father's, its tips wound with reed bark. The patched wings folded on her shoulders. A tired, bright look.
private: In her tent on the tall post at dusk: a loose undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled, the leather jerkin hung up, the wings loosened and half open, bare feet drawn up on a mat. She sews a patch on the edge of a wing with the bone needle. A sleepy, absorbed look.
battle: Flying the night run: the short leather jerkin with her wings spread wide, the six waterskins full and heavy at her belt, the short reed-wrapped bow gripped in one hand, bare feet tucked, the teal eyes wide in the dark.
formal: For the spring feast: a clean sleeveless dark teal dress with a soft rolled collar, open in two long gaps at the back for the wings, the nine patches on the wings neatly darned with thread that glints faintly, the braid behind the ear threaded with a pale ribbon, bare feet. She stands with the wings folded, a shy, composed look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait from slightly below, the face tilted, the teal eyes narrowed against a dim light and looking straight at the viewer, lips closed, a wary, bright look. Cold blue dusk light from one side, the nine patches on the folded wing edge visible beside her. Foreground blur: a leather waterskin and drifting dust. She wears the short leather jerkin closed at the collar.

name: 哈诺
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:1666
who: Hano, a bone-white demon-kin man of the Whitebone line, four hundred years old but looking twenty-six or twenty-seven, who writes down names beside the gate of Grey Rain City: about 181 cm, tall and thin, light-boned, with a bone-close, near-human build. Skin pale; the knuckles, collarbones and brow bones gleam white. Pale ash-grey hair grown long and tied at the back of the neck with a leather cord. Grey-white eyes that stay open even at night. The little finger of the left hand bent crooked, on the viewer's right when they face us, which he set himself at eight and which never straightened. A small copper bell tied on his left wrist. A quiet, watchful, patient air; he remembers everything.
build: 181 cm, tall and thin, light-boned: narrow shoulders, long limbs, a straight sitting back.
palette: bone white and ash silver, rain-grey wool, small copper, charcoal black
casual: His everyday wear at the gate: a washed-pale grey rain-city cloak over a plain dark long-sleeved tunic that closes down the front with buttons, a small copper bell from the Longwheel family tied on his left wrist (on the viewer's right), two leather pouches at his belt, one for blank books and charcoal sticks, the other for one old worn notebook with rounded corners. A calm, level look.
private: At the gate house at night: a plain undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled, a dark wool waistcoat, bare forearms showing the bent left little finger, the leather cord loosened so the silver hair falls to the shoulder. He sits writing a name in a book with a charcoal stick, the copper bell on his wrist. A quiet, absorbed look.
battle: At the gate in the rain: the washed-pale grey cloak thrown back over the tunic, the copper bell on his left wrist, the two pouches at his belt, a notebook held open in the left hand and a charcoal stick poised in the right, the grey-white eyes watching a face and a wrist.
battle_pose: 3) the outfit of the gate: standing very still and upright, a calm, watchful expression, an open notebook in one hand and a charcoal stick held poised in the other, as if about to write a name; he carries no weapon.
formal: For the day the names are read: a clean dark grey wool long coat of Grey Rain City with a folded-down collar and big dark buttons, the pale grey cloak clasped on the shoulders with a plain pin, the copper bell kept on his wrist and ringing very softly, polished boots, the hair tied neatly. He holds the old notebook closed against his chest, a grave, quiet look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the head tilted slightly, the grey-white eyes looking straight at the viewer, lips closed, a calm, remembering look; the bent little finger and the copper bell visible at the edge of the frame. Cold grey rain light from one side. Foreground blur: slanting rain, a charcoal stick and the corner of a notebook. He wears the washed-pale grey cloak over the dark tunic closed at the collar.

name: 马雷克
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:1722
who: Marek, a human apprentice stone-carver in the stone-cutter's house inside the north gate of Grey Rain City, twenty-four: about 176 cm, medium height, broad-shouldered with thick forearms from swinging a mallet. Orange-red curly hair always dusted with stone powder. A smear of charcoal on his face. Thick calluses across the right palm at the base of the thumb; an old cut on the left thumb (on the viewer's right) from a chisel slipping in his first year of learning to carve. Light green eyes that lean close to the lettering. A patient, steady, slightly shy air.
build: 176 cm, medium height, broad through the shoulders: thick forearms, strong hands, a sturdy stance.
palette: orange-red and stone grey, charcoal black, light green, leather apron brown
casual: His apprentice's clothes: a short leather apron cut down to fit him over a rough coarse shirt with the sleeves rolled, a pouch at his belt holding five chisels of different sizes, an oilcloth roll on his back with rubbing paper and charcoal sticks, and in his right hand an iron brazier with a wet cloth wound round its rim, full of glowing coals from the south gate. A calm, careful look.
private: In the carvers' house at night: a plain undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled, the leather apron off, soft shoes, charcoal still smudged on his cheek. He bends close over a lettered stone with a small brush, dusting it. A tired, absorbed look.
battle: Carrying the coals up the street: the leather apron with the chisel pouch, the oilcloth roll on his back, the iron brazier of glowing coals raised in his right hand like a shield with the wet cloth steaming, a chisel gripped in his left hand.
battle_pose: 3) the outfit of the brazier-carrying: braced and steady, a determined expression, an iron brazier of glowing coals held out in his right hand, a stonecutter's chisel in his left hand held low; he is not a fighter.
formal: For the stone-setting day: a clean dark wool coat that closes down the front with buttons over a white shirt, the stone powder brushed from his hair, the chisel pouch left off, polished boots, a roll of paper under his arm. He stands upright, a modest, careful look.
art: A close portrait, the head tilted slightly, the light green eyes leaning close then looking straight at the viewer, lips closed, a quiet, steady look; stone dust catching in his orange-red curls. Warm orange glow from a brazier on one side. Foreground blur: glowing coals, rising sparks and a chisel. He wears the leather apron over the coarse shirt, closed at the collar.
